skills.name: video-transcription
skills.description: Transcribe video files (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM) or YouTube URLs into text transcripts with speaker labels, chapters, and AI summary. Powered by OpenAI Whisper large-v3 with 98.5%+ accuracy.

skills.name: subtitle-generation
skills.description: Generate broadcast-ready SRT and VTT subtitle files from video files or YouTube URLs with AI-powered timing.

skills.name: subtitle-translation
skills.description: Translate SRT or VTT subtitle files to 70+ languages while preserving exact timestamps.

skills.name: youtube-transcript
skills.description: Generate transcripts from YouTube videos by URL. No download required. Returns full transcript, subtitles, summary, and chapters.

skills.name: subtitle-format-conversion
skills.description: Convert between subtitle formats: SRT, VTT, SBV, ASS/SSA, TTML/DFXP. Runs entirely in-browser.

skills.name: burn-subtitles
skills.description: Permanently embed (hardcode) SRT or VTT subtitles into a video file for burned-in captions.

skills.name: video-compression
skills.description: Compress video files with light, medium, or heavy compression. Runs in-browser using FFmpeg WASM.

skills.name: voice-to-text
skills.description: Record voice in-browser and get an accurate transcript immediately. Supports 99 languages.
